dimensions.policy: custom rectangular base plate envelope, 125 x 75 x 6 mm, with interface cut/axis markers only.

primitives.frame: base_plate_frame: origin at base plate lower-face center; XY footprint, +Z through 6 mm plate thickness.
primitives.notes: No interface signature was attached; downstream CAD must use the spec envelope.

primitives.frame: motor_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm; front face flush to base_plate_bottom_plane; body extends -Z.
primitives.notes: Motor body is a box proxy; shaft and connector details remain confirm-before-final.

primitives.frame: motor_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm; front face flush to base_plate_bottom_plane; body extends -Z.
motor_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with motor shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.
primitives.notes: Belt proxy preserves pitch and belt mid-plane only.

primitives.frame: output_shaft_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm, crossing belt mid-plane at Z=13.5 mm.
primitives.notes: Shaft/bore proxy preserves nominal coaxial interface.

primitives.frame: output_shaft_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm, crossing belt mid-plane at Z=13.5 mm.
output_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.
primitives.notes: Belt proxy preserves pitch and belt mid-plane only.

primitives.frame: output_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.

primitives.frame: output_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.
bearing_frame: bearing bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm; seated in support block.
primitives.notes: Bearing proxy preserves bore, outer seat, and axial width.

primitives.frame: bearing_frame: bearing bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm; seated in support block.

dimensions.policy: custom support block envelope with 608 bearing seat and M3 fastener axes; fillets and retainer details simplified.

primitives.frame: support_block_frame: origin at output shaft axis on top face of base plate; bearing pocket axis +Z.
primitives.notes: No interface signature was attached; downstream CAD must use the spec envelope.

primitives.frame: belt_frame: belt centerline in XY plane at Z=13.5 mm, tangent to both pulley pitch circles.
primitives.notes: Belt proxy preserves pitch and belt mid-plane only.

primitives.frame: motor_fastener_pattern_frame: four +Z axes on 31 mm square centered at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm.
primitives.notes: Fastener proxy marks clearance axes and pattern intent.

primitives.frame: support_fastener_pattern_frame: four +Z axes around bearing support block, centered at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm.
primitives.notes: Fastener proxy marks clearance axes and pattern intent.

relationships.statement: NEMA 17 front mounting face is flush to the base plate bottom datum plane.
Bearing support block bottom face is flush to the base plate top datum plane.
Belt width envelope plus 2 mm lateral clearance remains clear of support and fastener head envelopes.
NEMA 17 motor is fixed to the base plate using four M3 fastener axes on a 31 mm square pattern centered on the motor shaft.
Motor pulley bore and pitch circle are coaxial with the NEMA 17 motor shaft axis.
608 bearing outer race is centered in the support block bearing seat.
Output shaft, 608 bearing bore, and output pulley bore share the same +Z axis.
GT2 belt centerline is tangent to both pulley pitch circles in the shared belt mid-plane.
Bearing support block is fixed to the top of the base plate by M3 fastener axes outside the belt keep-out.
Motor pulley rotates about the NEMA 17 shaft axis with the motor rotor.
Output shaft and output pulley rotate about the 608 bearing bore axis.
Equal 20T GT2 pulleys transmit motor rotation to output shaft at 1:1 ratio.

root_frame.axes: +X motor-to-output shaft, +Y lateral span direction in the base plane, +Z up, shaft axis direction, and pulley/belt width direction
root_frame.notes: Vertical parallel-shaft architecture with motor below the base plate and pulleys above it.
